notes: 同步落地时新增「卸载残留清理」。① profile\node_modules 里指向已不存在目标的孤儿链接：插件卸载只删了安装目录和依赖、却漏掉那条 junction（实测 dsh-image-search 目标已删、链接还指着它），同步也从来不管。现在按「是链接 + 所有 Target 都不存在 + 不在 dependencies 里」三条同时成立才删，三条正常 link 插件一律不动，日志逐条列出删了谁。② 插件备份 <目录>.bak-<时间戳>：与在用版本相同的判为冗余直接清掉，版本不同的只留最新一份；主目录已不存在的备份保留（可能是唯一回滚点）。同时修掉本地插件的部署判据：原来比 mtime，而 git checkout/fetch 会把归档的 mtime 刷成当前时间，于是每轮同步都误判「有新版本」，反复把目录改名备份再重新解压（dsh-purge-1.1.92 与 .bak-时间戳 并存、每轮多搬一次目录就是这么攒出来的）。改成比归档内 package.json 的 version 与已部署目录的 version，不同才算新版本；读不到版本时退回 mtime 且要求新 10 秒以上。
notesEn: Landing now cleans uninstall leftovers. (1) Orphan links in profile node_modules whose target no longer exists: uninstalling a plugin deletes the install directory and the dependency, but sometimes leaves the junction behind (measured on dsh-image-search: target gone, link still pointing at it), and syncing never touched it. It is now removed only when all three hold at once - it is a link, none of its targets exist, and it is absent from dependencies - so the three healthy link plugins are never touched, and each removal is logged. (2) Plugin backups <dir>.bak-<timestamp>: a backup whose version equals the live one is redundant and gets deleted; different versions keep only the newest; if the live directory is gone the backup is kept as the only rollback point.The local-plugin deploy check was also fixed: it used to compare mtime, and because git checkout/fetch stamps the archive with the current time, every sync round wrongly concluded "new version" and renamed the directory into a backup and re-extracted it again (that is how dsh-purge-1.1.92 and .bak-timestamp ended up side by side, with one extra directory move per round). It now compares the version inside the archive package.json against the deployed one, and only falls back to mtime (with a 10-second margin) when the version cannot be read.
